tools.name: get_seed_format
tools.description: Returns the complete specification (markdown) for calaf_seed: 1 JSON documents — the format to follow when a user asks for a Calaf seed. Read it before authoring; then check your draft with validate_seed.

tools.name: validate_seed
tools.description: Runs a draft seed document through the exact parser the Calaf app imports with. Pass the entire JSON document as a string.
